text:
alex.w: Quick heads-up — Halcyon (private/VPC) scheduled deploy tomorrow 03:00 UTC window. We need final sign-offs on smoke owners, rollback plan, and who will be the main deployer.

maria_o: I can be on-call for the window. I'll own the smoke checks unless someone else volunteers.

jing.sre: I'll run the rollback play if needed and be on standby for infra rollbacks. Please post the exact kube namespace + helm release.

alex.w: Thanks — helm release is `halcyon-prod`, namespace `customer-halcyon`. Deployer will be @taylor.p. Taylor — can you confirm you have the access and the canary knobs ready?

sam_cs: FYI Halcyon CS has notified the customer and they're aware of the quiet window. They've asked for a 30-minute heads-up before cutover.

taylor.p: Confirmed I have access to the VPC jump host and helm creds. I'll run canary on 10% traffic for 15m then scale. Plan: deploy -> canary -> smoke -> promote.

alex.w: Smoke checklist (quick):
```
- health endpoints OK (/health, /live)
- API readiness < 200ms p50 for sample set
- token auth working against customer's IdP
- KV cache warm for recent prefixes
- sample generation matches baseline prompts (promptset: halcyon-smoke-2026)
```

maria_o: I'll run the sample generation and readouts. Post results here. If anything is off, we abort and rollback.

jing.sre: Rollback runbook link: https://internal.redwood/rollbacks/halcyon — main steps are: helm rollback, purge cache, revert routing. I'll also keep `kubectl` session ready.

deploy-bot: Deploy checklist: infra checks green, quotas OK, certs valid. Preflight passed.

alex.w: Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when they can be present at 02:45 UTC for final sync? Also add any last-minute concerns.

taylor.p: :thumbsup: I'll be there and will post the canary metrics.

maria_o: :thumbsup:

jing.sre: :thumbsup: I'll join voice if needed.

sam_cs: I'll send the 30-min customer heads-up at 02:30 UTC.

alex.w: Thanks team. Post-deploy plan: 15m canary metrics window, then 30m warm-up, then promote. If rollback triggered, estimated RTO 20–30m. I'll update this thread with the deploy command when we start.

taylor.p: Copy. Saving the deploy command here for when we go:```
helm upgrade --install halcyon-prod ./charts/halcyon --namespace customer-halcyon --set image.tag=2026.03.12-canary
```

maria_o: I'll paste smoke outputs here immediately after checks.

(END)
